page_title: Type2Phone–Use Your Mac as Keyboard for iPhone, iPad & Apple TV

sources.entry: Type2Phone - Use Your Mac as Keyboard for iPhone, iPad & Apple TV.

summary.name: Type2Phone
summary.one_liner: Type2Phone is a Mac utility that emulates a Bluetooth keyboard so you can type on an iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV using your Mac's keyboard; it has been discontinued.
keywords: paste passwords from mac to iphone
use_cases: Typing on an iPhone or iPad with the Mac's full-sized keyboard
Pasting passwords or addresses from Mac to a mobile device
Replying to email on iPhone-only accounts from a Mac keyboard
Controlling a 2nd or 3rd generation Apple TV with a keyboard
Sharing one keyboard across Mac and iOS devices
summary.what_it_does: Type2Phone runs on the Mac and emulates a Bluetooth keyboard, so an iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV pairs with the Mac and receives typed input. It connects automatically when you start typing and can disconnect when idle or when sent to the background. Users can copy and paste text from the Mac to the iOS device, and set customizable keyboard shortcuts. It also offers AppleScript automation, Command-Tab switching, and support for Mac dictation, TextExpander, and iOS VoiceOver. Setup involves pairing the Mac in Bluetooth settings and running Type2Phone in the foreground.
notable: Emulates a Bluetooth keyboard, so no extra app is needed on the iOS device
Copy-paste text from Mac to iPhone, iPad or Apple TV
Discontinued; no longer available for download
caveats: Discontinued and no longer available for download
Requires OS X 10.6.6 or later; tested with iOS 9.1 and OS X 10.11 El Capitan
Previously paired devices must first unpair on both ends before setup
